Package index

Declare & describe composition

Build the compD object, with validation, zero imputation and optional compositional outlier flagging, and describe it with tidy tables and plots.

declare_composition()
Declare a compositional variable
comp_impute()
Impute compositional zeroes
comp_outliers()
Detect compositional outliers
print(<compD>)
Print a compositional variable
summary(<compD>)
Describe a compositional variable
print(<summary_compD>)
Print a compositional variable summary
plot(<compD>)
Visualize a compositional variable
pub_ready()
Build publication-ready tables from a timecoda summary

Composition as predictor

Model the composition as an independent variable across eleven model engines, with a publication effect table and a predicted-outcome plot.

comp_iv()
Model a composition as an independent variable
summary(<comp_iv>)
Summarize a composition-as-predictor model
print(<summary_comp_iv>)
Print a composition-as-predictor summary
plot(<comp_iv>)
Visualize a composition-as-predictor model
print(<timecoda_fit>)
Print a timecoda model fit
ilr()
Composition marker for comp_iv() formulas

Reallocation & prediction

Estimate the effects of time reallocations from a comp_iv() fit, plot them, tabulate them for publication, and search the fit for an optimal composition.

predict_realloc()
Predict time-reallocation effects
summary(<realloc>)
Summarize time-reallocation effects
print(<summary_realloc>)
Print a time-reallocation summary
optimal_composition() print(<optimal_comp>) plot(<optimal_comp>) experimental
Search for the optimal composition (Goldilocks zone)
plot_realloc() print(<realloc_plots>)
Plot a time-reallocation sweep

Visualization

Standalone ternary and variation-matrix plots.

plot_ternary()
Ternary plot(s) of a composition
plot_variation()
Heatmap of the compositional variation matrix

Diagnostics

Goodness-of-fit and residual diagnostics matched to the fitted model class.

fit_check()
Check the goodness of fit of a composition model

Composition helpers

Validation, the ILR transform and its inverse, and other composition utilities.

check_composition()
Validate a compositional dataset
ilr_transform()
Isometric log-ratio (pivot) coordinates of a composition
ilr_backtransform()
Back-transform ILR coordinates to a composition
geom_mean_comp()
Geometric mean composition
variation_matrix()
Compositional variation matrix

Data

Example dataset shipped with the package.

timeuse
Simulated 24-hour time-use dataset
